$comment: ecu: ecu's own state, which no reader of live sees. Today one key per source, sessions.open.<src>: the open session and its running summary, which a restarted ecu continues or ends from (contracts' subjects.yaml; paddock#72, paddock#76).
This file is not a stream config: bootstrap.sh turns each field into the flag of the same name for nats kv add and nats kv edit.
history 1: ecu reads only the current value, and clears it with a revision check when the session ends.

max_value_size 1 MiB (1048576): the running summary carries every lap so far, a few KB for a short race and tens of KB for a long one. It is the same summary session.ended carries on EVENTS, so it is held to the same bound, the server's max_payload (1 MiB by default): a session ecu can end, it can also keep.
max_bucket_size 64 MiB (67108864): one key per source, and a replay clears its key when its session ends, so the bucket holds a few values. The limit is a backstop so the bucket cannot fill the disk.
No ttl: an open session stays until ecu ends it; whether it is continued is ecu's choice (its continue window), not the bucket's.
Discard and duplicate window are not set here: nats kv add fixes them for every bucket (discard new, so a full bucket refuses a write rather than dropping an open session).
replicas 1: one NATS server (ADR 0004). File storage, since the bucket exists to outlive a restart.
description: ecu's own state, the open session per source (paddock#73).
